name: Universal LPC sprite sheets (CC0 / CC-BY / CC-BY-SA / OGA-BY / GPL per layer)
licence_summary: Each image is available under one or more of CC0, CC-BY, CC-BY-SA, OGA-BY or GPL. Credit all authors except for CC0 art; CC-BY-SA derivatives must be CC-BY-SA 4.0+, GPL derivatives GPL 3.0+; CC-BY/CC-BY-SA may not be DRM-protected, OGA-BY may.

attribution.credit_template: Sprites contributed as part of the Liberated Pixel Cup project from OpenGameArt.org; authors: {authors from the exported credits}

cautions: Ship the exported credits (or CREDITS.csv) where users can find them, e.g. a credits screen or the video description link.
Share-alike layers make derived sprites share-alike too; keep them out of packages with other licences.
